items.title: Tasbih after every prayer
items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.tr: Subhan Allah (33×), al-hamdu lillah (33×), Allahu akbar (33×).
items.en: Glory be to Allah. All praise is for Allah. Allah is the greatest.

items.title: Completing the hundred
items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.tr: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ʿala kulli shay’in qadir.
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.

items.title: Subhan Allahi wa bihamdih
items.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him.
items.benefits: Said a hundred times in a day, the narration states his sins are removed though they be like the foam of the sea.

items.title: The two light words
items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.tr: Subhan Allahi wa bihamdih, Subhan Allahil-ʿAzim.
items.en: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah the Magnificent.
items.benefits: Light on the tongue, heavy on the scales, beloved to the Most Merciful.

items.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
items.tr: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana ʿabduk, wa ana ʿala ʿahdika wa waʿdika mastataʿt, aʿudhu bika min sharri ma sanaʿt, abu’u laka biniʿmatika ʿalayya wa abu’u laka bidhanbi, faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
items.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and Your promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me — for none forgives sins but You.
items.benefits: Called the most excellent manner of seeking forgiveness. Said morning and evening.

items.title: Seeking forgiveness
items.en: I seek Allah’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance.

items.title: The treasure of Paradise
items.ar: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
items.tr: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.en: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
items.benefits: Described in the narration as a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.
